corepack: not found

findings.body:
🤖 Fixed in c3338e98c9. Both Dockerfiles now run `npm install -g corepack@0.36.0` before `corepack enable`, so the `packageManager` pin still applies. Checked on Node 26.13.0: it ships only `npm`/`npx`, and after the install `corepack prepare --activate` activates `pnpm@11.0.0`. Also updated `docs/pages/faqs.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `AGENTS.md`.

Images are still not built by any PR check, so a local `docker build` is the remaining verification before merge.
